stories.title: Miembro de los scouts, voluntaria tras la erupción del volcán de La Palma: la estudiante asesinada en México estaba "ilusionada" con su estancia y participaba en unos talleres de medicina tradicional

en.title: Scout member and volunteer after La Palma volcano eruption: student killed in Mexico was "excited" about her stay and participated in traditional medicine workshops
en.summary: A Granada University student who was murdered in Mexico had been volunteering and taking part in traditional medicine workshops. She had contacted her tutor the day before, reporting that everything was going well.

stories.title: El Camp Nou será la sede de la final de la Champions 2029

en.title: Camp Nou will host the 2029 Champions League final
en.summary: UEFA has designated Camp Nou as the venue for the 2029 Champions League final, with the Munich Football Arena hosting the 2028 final.

stories.title: España hará doblete en dos años: el Camp Nou acogerá la final de la Champions de 2029

en.title: Spain will achieve a double in two years: Camp Nou will host the 2029 Champions League final
en.summary: UEFA confirmed that Camp Nou will host the 2029 Champions League final, selected over Wembley Stadium. Spain will host two of the three upcoming major continental finals within two years.

stories.title: Aviones de combate de la OTAN derriban un dron sobre Lituania por primera vez

en.title: NATO combat aircraft shoot down a drone over Lithuania for the first time
en.summary: NATO fighter jets downed a drone over Lithuania. Residents of the capital received mobile phone alerts instructing them to take cover.

stories.title: La denuncia de la hermana de Claudia, la estudiante asesinada en México: “¿Tenemos que normalizar que se asesine a tres mujeres en un mes en la misma universidad?"

en.title: The complaint from Claudia's sister, the student murdered in Mexico: "Do we have to normalize that three women are murdered in one month at the same university?"
en.summary: Laura Taraconte posted a video on social media condemning her sister's death and criticizing what she describes as a sick society that has normalized violence against women at the university.

stories.title: Lara, hermana de Claudia Tacoronte: ¿De verdad normalizamos que maten a tres mujeres en la misma universidad?

en.title: Lara, Claudia Tacoronte's sister: Do we really normalize killing three women at the same university?
en.summary: Lara Tacoronte expressed concern that Claudia was not warned before attending a university where two other women had been killed in the previous year, a situation that alarmed her parents.

stories.title: La UEFA escoge el Spotify Camp Nou como sede de la final de la Champions League de 2029

en.title: UEFA chooses Spotify Camp Nou as venue for 2029 Champions League final
en.summary: Barcelona's stadium has been selected to host the 2029 Champions League final, marking the third time the venue will stage Europe's most important club football match.

stories.title: Pablo Fernández se presenta a las primarias de Podemos para ser candidato al Ayuntamiento de Madrid

en.title: Pablo Fernández presents himself in Podemos primaries to be candidate for Madrid City Council
en.summary: Podemos co-spokesperson Pablo Fernández announced his candidacy in the party's primary elections for Madrid municipal elections, running alongside party leader Ione Belarra.

stories.title: Pablo Fernández da el paso para ser el candidato de Podemos al Ayuntamiento de Madrid

en.title: Pablo Fernández takes step to be Podemos candidate for Madrid City Council
en.summary: Pablo Fernández has announced his candidacy as Podemos' representative for the Madrid municipal elections.

stories.title: Podemos lanza a su número tres, Pablo Fernández, como candidato a la Alcaldía de Madrid

en.title: Podemos launches its number three, Pablo Fernández, as candidate for Madrid Mayor
en.summary: Podemos has launched Pablo Fernández, the party's organizational secretary, as its candidate for Madrid's mayoral position. He advocates for shifting Madrid from speculation-driven policies toward making housing affordable for residents.

stories.title: Cazas de la OTAN interceptan un dron en el espacio aéreo de Lituania

en.title: NATO fighter jets intercept drone in Lithuanian airspace
en.summary: Italian NATO fighter jets detected and shot down an unidentified drone over Lithuania's Kaisiadorys district after it penetrated Lithuanian airspace. The drone may have been carrying explosives, prompting officials to issue air danger alerts to residents.

stories.title: 'La maldición de Widow's Bay' y 'The Pitt' triunfan en los Premios Emmy 2026

en.title: 'The Curse of Widow's Bay' and 'The Pitt' triumph at 2026 Emmy Awards
en.summary: The horror series 'The Curse of Widow's Bay' and medical drama 'The Pitt' won major awards at the 78th Emmy Awards. The AppleTV horror series won 14 statues, setting a new genre record, with victories for its lead Matthew Rhys and supporting actors.

stories.title: El ejército de EEUU reconoce que tiene armas en el espacio

en.title: U.S. military acknowledges it has weapons in space
en.summary: The U.S. military has acknowledged possessing weapons in space. Security experts warn that this disclosure could trigger weapons proliferation among other governments.

en.title: Ibex extends its decline
en.summary: The Ibex index continues falling as oil prices, debt concerns, and Federal Reserve actions pressure European equity markets, though losses moderate for artificial intelligence-related stocks.

stories.title: Lidl y Dia disparan su crecimiento frente a la estabilización de Mercadona

en.title: Lidl and Dia surge in growth against Mercadona's stabilization
en.summary: Lidl has gained 0.4 percentage points in market share year-to-date and narrows the gap with Carrefour, while Mercadona remains the market leader with a 0.1 percentage point increase.

stories.title: Por qué Europa teme más el rally del gas que el del petróleo

en.title: Why Europe fears the gas rally more than the oil rally
en.summary: Natural gas prices are rising more steeply than oil this year. Analysts note that Europe and the European Central Bank increasingly worry about gas prices rather than oil prices.

stories.title: La IA entusiasma a las firmas de auditoría, quizás demasiado

en.title: AI Enthusiasms Audit Firms, Perhaps Too Much
en.summary: Audit firms including KPMG and EY are rapidly adopting artificial intelligence technology, though it still requires human intervention in its operations.
